'''Cave moss''' is a peculiar [[grass]]-like growth that occurs in underground [[caverns]]. Animals such as [[cow|cattle]] or [[yak]]s can be designated to graze on it via [[pasture]]s.

Cave moss is functionally identical to [[floor fungus]], but should not be confused with normal [[moss]].  As with [[Caverns#Benefits|most underground grasses]], cave moss only appears after a [[caverns|cavern]] containing cave moss has been discovered.

Cave moss will grow on a below ground [[soil]] surface or on a muddied stone surface that has not been smoothed.  The amount of mud on the surface does not affect the distribution or growth rate of subterranean plants [http://www.bay12forums.com/smf/index.php?topic=122150].

Cave moss is harmless.
